name: Sergio Joseph Calderon
office: Water Replenishment District of Southern California, Member, Board of Directors, Division 4

items.text: Sergio Joseph Calderon is the Division 4 director on the Water Replenishment District of Southern California board, elected in 2006. He works as a teacher and adviser for the Los Angeles Unified School District's adult education division. He says he previously served as a mayor, councilmember, and city clerk. He supports the district's Water Independence Now program, which seeks independence from imported water for basin recharge.
